title: Higher Verlinde fiber functors in positive characteristic
exact_target: For every prime p, every algebraically closed field k of characteristic p and every finite symmetric tensor category C over k, do there exist $n\geq 1$ and an exact faithful k-linear symmetric tensor functor $C\to Ver_{p^n}(k)$?
